rule_or_pattern: Drop lines flagged C:cph_out_of_range or C:cpp_vs_book_out (label is only a fragment of the printed verse line, or belongs to a neighbouring line). This also removes a few correct all-caps song titles, which is acceptable for a test-split book.
notes: This is a folk-song anthology. Ordinary verse lines read correctly with polytonic marks and the dialect spellings as printed (1-10, 12-20, 25, 26, 28, 36). However, a clear subset of crops has a label holding only part of the line or a different line. Line 11 omits 'πιθαμὴ τὸ νύχι!'; 22, 24 and 37-39 carry labels from another line ('κ᾿ ἐκάψασι τὰ σπήτια·' under 'Κ᾿ εὐθὺς φωτιὰν ἐδώκασιν…', 'καθισμένος' under 'Κάθε κορφὴ καὶ φλάμπουρο…'). 23, 27, 29, 32-34 and 40 are truncated or mixed. All of these carry C:cph_out_of_range, and most also carry cpp_vs_book_out. The book is in the test split, so this subset must go.
